SEQUENCE 4.  c_n(3) = number of placements of a white king, a black king (not adjacent) and one more man
(one of 10 kinds; pawns only on ranks 2..n-1) on an n X n board.  Offset 3.
Formula: a(n) = 10n^6 - 4n^5 - 110n^4 + 164n^3 + 92n^2 - 272n + 112.
